name: softn-examples
description: The SoftN example applications: every demo in the softn.com directory as source, with the scripts that pack, test and release them.

scripts.test: npm run test:logic && npm run test:minemanagement && npm run test:validators && npm run test:promptly && npm run test:bundles
scripts.test:logic: node scripts/test/texasholdem/test-gameplay.cjs && node scripts/test/texasholdem/test-authority.cjs && node scripts/test/texasholdem/test-authority-client.cjs && node scripts/test/texasholdem/test-authority-http.cjs && node scripts/test/test-warblewire-protocol.cjs
scripts.test:promptly: node scripts/test/promptly/check-geometry.cjs && node scripts/test/promptly/check-spawns.cjs && node scripts/test/promptly/check-audio.cjs
